gui.stockmarket.management_screen.genera:
Puts all markets into maintenance mode: players can no longer trade, and their open orders are cancelled and refunded.
Bots keep trading.
This is useful when you want to change settings of the market and
prevent players from exploiting strong changes in price due to changing settings.
Or if things get out of hand and you need a quick way to stop all player trading.
Ends maintenance mode on all markets so that players can trade again.

Resets the historical data for all markets.
All charts will be reset to the current market price.
This is useful when you want to start fresh with the markets.
Do you really want to reset the price chart for all markets?

Do you really want to delete all markets?
This will remove all markets and all bots.
All open orders will be closed and the market data will be lost.
This can not be undone!

Reset all fields to their default values.

gui.stockmarket.mod_settings_screen.rest:
This value is only read once at server startup.
Changes are saved to settings.json but only take
effect after a server restart.
gui.stockmarket.mod_settings_screen.appl:
Recomputes the max order size of EVERY market from its
abundance and the SAVED factor (asks for confirmation).
Recompute max order size of all markets?

Sets the max order size of ALL %1$s markets to max(%2$s, %2$s x abundance).
Custom per-market limits (including 0 = unlimited) are overwritten.
Uses the SAVED factor %2$s - press Apply first to use an edited value.
Max order size recomputed for %s markets (factor %s)
gui.stockmarket.mod_settings_screen.sett: Autosave interval (minutes)

How often all StockMarket data is saved to disk.
Range: 1 - 1440 minutes.
Log info messages
Enable INFO log output of the StockMarket mod.
Log warnings
Enable WARNING log output of the StockMarket mod.
Log errors
Enable ERROR log output of the StockMarket mod.
Log debug messages
Enable DEBUG log output of the StockMarket mod.
Sync admin flag with LuckPerms

Two-way sync between the StockMarket admin flag and the
LuckPerms node stockmarket.admin. /stockmarket op|deop also
write the node; LuckPerms changes update the flag.
Does nothing without LuckPerms.
Orderbook array size

Size of the virtual orderbook price array of a market.
Only NEWLY created markets use the changed value;
existing markets keep their size until a server restart.
Range: 100 - 1000000.
Trading currency

The item all market trades settle in.
Cached at startup - changing it requires a server restart.
Candle time (ms)

Time span of one price candlestick in milliseconds.
Range: 1000 - 86400000 ms.
Price history: max candles / response

Server-side hard cap on the number of candles returned
by one price-history response. When exceeded, the oldest
candles are dropped and the client pages for more.
Range: 16 - 65536.
Price history: initial load candles

Number of candles the client requests when a chart first
opens. Larger values show more history immediately but
make the initial load slower.
Range: 16 - 8192.
Trading hours: use real time

When enabled, the trading hours of all markets follow the
local real time of the master server.
Otherwise the in-game time is used (tick 0 = 06:00).
Takes effect immediately.
Trade cooldown (ms)

Minimum time between two accepted orders of the same
player, across all markets (anti-autoclicker).
Rejected orders do not restart the cooldown.
Bots are not affected. 0 = off. Range: 0 - 60000 ms.
Takes effect immediately.
Max order size factor

Items per abundance unit for the DEFAULT max order size:
max(factor, factor x abundance). Used for new markets and
presets and for saves without a value. Existing markets keep
their limit - use 'Apply to all markets' to recompute them.
Minimum: 1. Takes effect immediately.
Net flow half-life (min)

Half-life of the faded net player flow that drives the
Volatility plugin's equilibrium price. A burst of trades
halves its effect after this time; steady trading keeps
working. The real net flow is not affected.
0 = no fading. Range: 0 - 10080. Default: 360 (6 h).
Takes effect immediately.
Virtual depth recovery half-life (min)

Virtual volume consumed outside the visible order book
window stays thin (if the price returns it meets little
volume) and recovers toward the default: the missing
part halves after this time.
0 = off. Range: 0 - 10080. Takes effect immediately.
Virtual depth price ceiling (x price)

No virtual sell volume exists above this multiple of the
current price. A buy that walks the book stops there and
its remainder is canceled.
Range: 2 - 10000. Takes effect immediately.
Profit alert threshold

Realized trading profit (sell proceeds minus buy costs,
all markets) one player may make within the alert window
before online admins get a chat alert and the server log
records it. Cash based: selling old stock also counts.
0 = off. Takes effect immediately.
Profit alert window (min)

Length of the window for the profit alert, in minutes.
Range: 1 - 10080. Takes effect immediately.
Villager trading enabled
Master switch for stock-market-driven villager trade repricing.
Price refresh interval (minutes)

Real-time minutes between villager price refreshes/broadcasts.
Range: 1 - 10080 minutes.
Villager buy margin

Multiplier on the market price when the villager BUYS from the player.
Below 1.0 = villager pays less than market value.
Range: 0.01 - 100.
Villager sell margin

Multiplier on the market price when the villager SELLS to the player.
Above 1.0 = villager charges more than market value.
Range: 0.01 - 100.
Replace emeralds for unlisted items

Also convert emerald trades of items WITHOUT a market into money,
using the emerald market price (emerald count × emerald price × margin).
Requires an emerald market; otherwise these trades stay emerald-based.

gui.stockmarket.market_settings_widget.n:
Net number of items players traded with this market
(counted per fill, bot orders excluded).
Positive: players sold more items into the market than
they bought -> extra supply, pushes the equilibrium
price down.
Negative: players bought more than they sold -> extra
demand, pushes the equilibrium price up.
Real counter, never fades. The Volatility plugin uses the
faded value below. Reset sets both to 0.
gui.stockmarket.market_settings_widget.f:
The net flow above, but fading towards 0 over time
(half-life: Mod Settings > Net flow half-life).
A one-off burst of trades fades out, steady buying or
selling keeps it up. This is the value the Volatility
plugin uses for the equilibrium price; it always counts
every trade, the plugin limits its own price effect.
gui.stockmarket.plugin_gui.apply_all.too:
Apply these values to every market
subscribed to this plugin (asks for confirmation).
gui.stockmarket.plugin_gui.defaults.tool:
Fill the form with the plugin's default values.
Nothing is changed until you press Apply
(this market) or Apply to all.
gui.stockmarket.plugin_gui.apply_all_con:
This overwrites the settings of ALL %2$s markets subscribed to the plugin "%1$s" with the values currently shown.
The previous per-market settings will be lost.
Amplitude of the random price walk, relative to the
equilibrium price. At 0.3 the price typically deviates
about +-4%, 90% of the time within +-12%,
rarely up to about +-26%.
0 = no random movement. Default: 0.3
gui.stockmarket.volatility_plugin.flow_e:
If enabled, net player trading permanently shifts the
equilibrium price: selling items lowers it, buying raises it.
If disabled, the price oscillates around the default price.
gui.stockmarket.volatility_plugin.flow_s:
Items (per unit of the item's natural abundance) players
must net-sell to lower the equilibrium price by a factor
of e (~2.72x). Higher = more inert market.
<= 0 disables the flow influence. Default: 2000
gui.stockmarket.volatility_plugin.min_pr:
Lower limit of the equilibrium price as a multiple of the
default price (0.05 = never below 5% of default).
Must be between 0 and 1, otherwise the default is used.
Default: 0.05
gui.stockmarket.volatility_plugin.max_pr:
Upper limit of the equilibrium price as a multiple of the
default price (3 = never above 3x default).
Must be greater than 1, otherwise the default is used.
Default: 3
gui.stockmarket.volatility_plugin.perman:
Largest lasting price shift as a fraction of the trade's
own impact on the default order book (0.5 = a big trade
still spikes the price, but at most half of that spike
stays). Lower = more inert market. Range: 0 - 1
(0 or invalid = default). Default: 0.5
Proportional gain: reacts to the current gap between
target price and market price. Higher = the bot trades
more aggressively toward the target.
The bot output (max +-1) is the fraction of the order book
volume up to the target price traded per step. Default: 0.5
Integral gain: accumulates the price gap over time to
remove a persistent offset from the target.
Too high causes overshoot and oscillation. Default: 0.1
Derivative gain: reacts to how fast the price gap
changes and dampens overshoot.
Default: 0 (off)
gui.stockmarket.target_price_bot.rate.to:
Limit of the integral term (anti-windup): caps how much
the accumulated price gap can add to the bot output.
Default: 0.1
gui.stockmarket.target_price_bot.max_ord:
Largest order the bot may place in one step, as a multiple
of this market's max player order size.
Limits how far one bot order can move the price.
0 = unlimited (also when the market has no player limit).
Default: 10
gui.stockmarket.target_price_bot.max_tar:
How fast the target price the bot chases may move, in
percent per second (compounding). A sudden jump of the
target (e.g. heavy player buying) is then followed slowly.
0 = no limit. Default: 0.5
gui.stockmarket.target_price_bot.reversi:
After a player pushes the price, the bot holds it there
and lets it return to the target over about this time
(time constant). 0 = off: the bot chases the target
right away. Default: 600 (10 min)
gui.stockmarket.target_price_bot.oscilla:
Length of one swing of the price around its way back
to the target. Default: 60

How fast the swings die out: 0 = they keep going,
1 = no overshoot. Default: 0.3

Size of the first swing towards the target, as a fraction
of the player's price push. The price never goes past
the target nor above the player's price. Default: 0.15
gui.stockmarket.volume_distribution.volu:
Multiplier for the virtual order book volume (additionally
scaled by the item's natural abundance). Higher = deeper
book, the price moves less per trade. Default: 1
gui.stockmarket.volume_distribution.spee:
Overall speed at which the virtual order book volume
converges to its target distribution. Multiplies both
rates below. Default: 0.05
gui.stockmarket.volume_distribution.accu:
Rate at which missing volume is refilled toward the target
(e.g. after players consumed liquidity). Default: 0.1
gui.stockmarket.volume_distribution.decu:
Rate at which excess volume is removed when a price level
holds more volume than its target. Default: 0.01
